text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report requests that Scarborough Community Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 29 Willsteven Drive. The application indicates the reason for removal is due to safety concerns related to branch failure. The subject tree is an American elm tree (Ulmus americana), measuring 124 cm in diameter. The Tree By-laws do not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Denied the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 29 Willsteven Drive.
